claim: The canonical crossed double boundary-banding of the two product annuli is genus one, not an annulus. Under the separately stated conditional framing hypothesis, the naive two-handle shortcut also fails, while a full mixed unimodular hyperbolic basis exists; integral framing alone therefore does not supply the missing compression or ambient-standardness.

scope.rules_out: Only the literal surface obtained from the two original product annuli by the two crossed boundary bands, without an additional compression or a different spanning annulus.
scope.does_not_rule_out: A different annulus with the same new boundary curves, or a compression of the canonical genus-one surface by a nonseparating disk in the disk exterior.

next_action: Specify one replayable crossed band pair and a candidate nonseparating compression disk (or a separately embedded annulus), then check its marked-group word, framing, boundary knot and ambient standardness before any broad search.
